leaf_cases.query: 复核 ShipBob 官方首页快照（2026-10-24 抓取）中 200+ 零售渠道、50+ 履约中心与集成表述，收窄 reason 中“50+ 集成”“同步商品”的措辞
leaf_cases.note: ShipBob 属履约服务的运营极点：卖家自有库存寄入其履约中心，拣货、打包、发货由服务商员工执行，卖家通过平台管理。读取原快照并抽取正文复核：原文为 '200+ Retail channels supported'、'50+ Fulfillment centers across the world'，集成句为 'Connect your ecommerce platform, sales channels, ERP, and dozens of other tools'；另有 App Store '50+ few-click integrations' 一句，但为避免与履约中心数字混淆，reason 不再引用该数字。此前 note 称正文未见“同步商品”有误：首页原文有 'Connect your store and sync your products in a couple clicks.'；本批 reason 未使用“同步商品”概括，故无需据此扩写。页面仍未逐项说明挂单（hold）、库位级分配与“渠道完成回传”机制，属证据缺口；未据此扩写。
leaf_cases.service_boundary: 卖家端履约管理；库存归卖家所有，由服务商在自有履约中心存储与作业，履约动作由服务商执行而非卖家自营仓库。

leaf_cases.note: 原有 /returns/ 快照为单行 Next.js HTML；去除 script/style 与 HTML 标签后正文可读，关键原文为 'an ecommerce returns portal that decides the right outcome automatically'、'customize your return policy settings across different regions, warehouses, products'、'exchanges and store credit instead of refunds'、'Customers that get an Instant Refund...'、'Offer flexible shipping & drop-off options ... multiple global carriers ... Happy Returns'。该页 FAQ 区块同时有 'Loop Returns is a self-service returns portal that automates your entire ecommerce returns process, from policy enforcement to resolution'；此前 repair 轮误将该句归到 /faq/ 快照，本轮回读 /faq/ 未检出该句或 'self-service returns portal'、'policy enforcement'，已把归属改回 /returns/。/faq/ 可核内容为 'Our self-service portal manages returns and exchanges without support involvement'、'checks return eligibility' 与 'full customization of return windows, product eligibility, geographic rules, fees, and exchange logic'；官网首页为 'Returns guides shoppers to exchanges or store credit instead of refunds'。另抓取两份官方文档；Deep Link 文档标题为 'Deep Link to a Customer Order in the Return Portal'，说明可将顾客直接带入其订单的退货门户；Return Actions 文档说明 Process Return 触发 refunds/exchanges/store credits，Flag 阻止自动处理并转人工复核。购物者侧生命周期展示与礼品退货流程在正文未见，留作缺口。
